name: stata-research-guard
description: Provide Stata command evidence, readable official or maintainer examples, and factual project observations while leaving command choice and code writing to the model.

interface.shortDescription: Official syntax and project-context evidence for Stata.
interface.longDescription: Provides task-separated Stata command candidates, readable StataCorp or maintainer documentation examples, factual project observations, and non-authoritative paper usage context. The model uses that evidence with the user's research and output requirements to choose commands and write readable project-specific code. The plugin does not rank candidates, promote templates, grade generated code, or certify a research design.
defaultPrompt: Use the skill and get_stata_command_evidence to choose and write readable Stata from official or maintainer examples and the current project context.
Inspect this Stata project read-only and report literal command, option, input, output, call, and estimate-handoff observations without ranking its existing practices.
Compare command candidates for this requested Stata function using authoritative documentation and relevant paper context, then make the project-specific choice yourself.
